content: Official Guardian core docs show inactive users denied before superuser acceptance by ObjectPermissionChecker. Shortcut docs independently default with_superuser=True and accept_global_perms=True; setting the latter False does not remove active-superuser semantics. Current app passes strict fallback False. https://django-guardian.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/core/ https://django-guardian.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/shortcuts/
